function objectDefault() {
  let saved: number;
  const { value = (saved = 1) } = { value: 2 };
  console.log(saved);
}
function arrayDefault() {
  let saved: number;
  const [value = (saved = 1)] = [2];
  console.log(saved);
}
function nestedDefault() {
  let saved: number;
  const { pair: [[value = (saved = 1)] = []] } = { pair: [[2]] };
  console.log(saved);
}
function narrowedDefault() {
  let saved: number | string = 1;
  const { value = (saved = 'assigned') } = { value: 'supplied' };
  console.log(saved.toUpperCase());
}
function definiteDefault() {
  let saved: number;
  const { value = (saved = 1) } = { value: undefined };
  console.log(saved);
}
function assignments() {
  let a: number;
  let b: number;
  let value: number;
  ({ value: value = (a = 1) } = { value: 2 });
  [value = (b = 1)] = [2];
  console.log(a, b, value);
}
